parts.text: When sodium hydrogen carbonate is heated at 60 °C, carbon dioxide is given off.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Complete the equation for this reaction. ......NaHCO 3 Na 2 CO 3 + CO 2 + ............. [2]

parts.label: ii

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) An aqueous solution of sodium hydrogen carbonate is slightly alkaline. Which one of the following pH values is slightly alkaline? Put a ring around the correct answer. pH 2 pH 7 pH 8 pH 13 [1]
